text:
sam (AE): FYI — Acme POC stuck on signature + billing path. Procurement is asking for a line-item pricing matrix and their PO template. Legal returned DPA redlines that add a subprocessor/data transfer restriction. Can we finalize today so we can start next week? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Lina (Legal): Ping — please attach their redline PDF. Quick Q: is their change an absolute ban on subprocessors or a notice/consent requirement? Absolute ban we push back on.
sam (AE): Uploaded their redline (internal link). They added: 'No transfer of data to third parties without prior written consent' under section 4.3 and bumped the SLA to 99.9%. Procurement says they will only issue a PO if OF references exact line items.
matt (RevOps): For the order form we need a clear pricing matrix (Seat fee, Token overage, Support add-on) + currency/tax line. If they send a PO, RevOps requires the PO to reference the OrderForm# exactly. Example PO body they usually send:
```text
PO#: 450123
Vendor: Redwood Inference, Inc.
OrderForm#: OF-2025-015
LineItems:
  - Product: Hosted API - Reserved Seats
    Qty: 10
    UnitPrice: 2000 USD
  - Product: Premium SLA
    Qty: 1
    UnitPrice: 1500 USD
Total (excl tax): 21500 USD
Currency: USD
```
ashley (Sales-Eng): From POC standpoint, keep support add-on optional. For SLA, offer 99.5% for POC and state upgrade path to 99.9% on Dedicated. Also we should include a short migration/cutover clause so they can flip to Dedicated later.
ben (Security): We can't accept an absolute 'no transfer' clause. Propose: allow subprocessors with contractual obligations + require KMS for customer-managed keys if they insist on extra control. Also confirm: do they require EU data residency or govcloud? That affects the OF wording.
Lina (Legal): Draft compromise: "Prior written consent not to be unreasonably withheld; customer will be provided a list of subprocessors and may object for legitimate security/regulatory reasons." I'll prepare a one-paragraph redline to replace their absolute ban.
sam (AE): Customer expects countersign EOD Friday to keep POC start next Monday. Ops — can we do OF-first and MSA to follow in parallel, or do we need fully executed MSA first?
matt (RevOps): We can accept OF-first only if: 1) the OF includes "subject to MSA" language, 2) Legal has the MSA/DPA redline in pipeline, and 3) RevOps has the billing contact + signer. RevOps will create DocuSign envelope once Legal posts final DPA text. Need customer signer name and billing contact.
docusign-bot: Created envelope OF-2025-015, status: awaiting signer 'Acme Procurement - Lisa Wong'
ashley (Sales-Eng): Billing contact is finance@acme.co — they requested NET30 terms. Finance ok with that? :moneybag:
maria (Finance): NET30 OK but PO must include Acme tax ID and billing address. If Acme is a government entity we also need their W-9 or equivalent.
Lina (Legal): I'll post the redlined DPA snippet in ~20m. If everyone is OK with the "OF-first with MSA in parallel" approach, I'll approve the DocuSign flow after I post the compromise language.
sam (AE): Great — checklist: 1) Lina posts DPA redline. 2) Matt produces pricing matrix + OF with 'subject to MSA' clause. 3) Ben confirms final KMS/subprocessor wording. 4) Send to Acme and kick off DocuSign. Tagging @matt @Lina @ben @maria. Thanks! :thumbsup:
